title: Bounds from machine serialization
statement: Let $M$ be a one-work-tape binary Turing machine in code normal form, with state set $\{0,\ldots,m\}$, initial state $q_0$, and canonical serialization of length $L$. Then the binary representation of $m$ has length at most $L$, the index of $q_0$ is at most $L$, and $m+1\le L$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a machine in code normal form
replaced: Let $M$ be a one-work-tape binary Turing machine in code normal form with state set $\{0,\dots,m\}$ and initial state $q_0$, and let $L$ be the length of its canonical serialization. Then the binary representation of $m$ has length at most $L$, $q_0 \le L$, and $m + 1 \le L$.
